charts.title: HD 15906 b: orbits around HD 15906
charts.description: The orbits of HD 15906's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 15906 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Tuson et al. 2023 (2023MNRAS.523.3090T), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname TUSON_ET_AL__2023): P 10.924709 d

charts.title: HD 15906 b: its transit
charts.description: HD 15906 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (4, 31) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 4646810, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 8 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 15 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 8 min early; 7-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 5 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
